implementation: Independent decoder and MuJoCo FK/IK. Uses reference replay ideas: column-based rotation, bounded least-squares, seed continuity, joint velocity limits. No runtime import or invocation of parent functions. Default waist copied as configuration value.
differences: G2 structural profile instead of Skye control semantics
Retain/report invalid or unmatched frames instead of aborting
MuJoCo FK instead of handwritten URDF FK
Offline Home seed instead of live robot joints
No robot endpoints, reset, chassis or gripper dispatch
